value.rationale: Thirty-class exact extension-field arithmetic invariant for a geometrically natural complete set of Zariski decompositions on a classical del Pezzo surface. Geiser twisting collapses rational chamber count from 33,645 to one in the split case, and distinct point partitions with the same rational Picard rank (6,1 and 5,2) yield different rational chamber counts. This refines the standard geometric 33,645 count, detects stable-base-locus behavior invisible to Picard rank and is a full natural finite classification rather than a routine parameter increment.
